# 公众号排版组件库 —— 松石阶梯

> 松石墨绿、金棕点缀与纸张卡片构成的效率方法论长文版式。

## 设计变量速查表

结构模型：阶梯式标题与编号列表建立操作路径；流程和条件优先于装饰卡片。

```json
{
  "color": {
    "paper": "#f9f8f4",
    "ink": "#333333",
    "muted": "#6f746f",
    "accent": "#2c4c3b",
    "soft": "#ebe8df"
  },
  "type": {
    "body": "Noto Sans SC, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif",
    "heading": "LXGW WenKai, LXGW WenKai Mono TC, Songti SC, Georgia, serif"
  },
  "size": {
    "title": "29px",
    "heading": "17px",
    "body": "14px",
    "meta": "11px"
  },
  "lineHeight": {
    "body": "1.85",
    "heading": "1.6",
    "compact": "1.5"
  },
  "alignment": {
    "left": "left",
    "center": "center",
    "right": "right",
    "justify": "justify"
  },
  "canvas": {
    "background": "#fcfbf8",
    "padding": "0 20px 96px"
  },
  "radius": "0px"
}
```

## 各组件完整实现

### masthead · masthead

- 默认变体：`source`
- 可接受：`article-title`
- Slot：`content:content`

组件定义：
```json
{
  "specVersion": "1.0",
  "id": "masthead",
  "template": "template.html",
  "kind": "masthead",
  "accepts": {
    "blockTypes": [
      "article-title"
    ]
  },
  "slots": [
    {
      "name": "content",
      "source": "content",
      "required": true
    }
  ],
  "fallbackVariant": "source",
  "baseStyles": {
    "r0": {
      "margin": "0 13px",
      "padding": "28px 24px 32px",
      "border-radius": "28px",
      "text-align": "left"
    },
    "r1": {
      "margin": "0 0 28px",
      "padding": "0"
    },
    "r2": {
      "aspect-ratio": "16 / 10",
      "overflow": "hidden"
    },
    "r3": {
      "display": "block",
      "width": "100%",
      "height": "100%",
      "object-fit": "cover"
    },
    "r4": {
      "display": "flex",
      "align-items": "center",
      "gap": "12px",
      "margin": "0 0 32px",
      "color": "#c49a6c",
      "font-family": "Iowan Old Style, STSong, Songti SC, Georgia, serif",
      "font-size": "10px",
      "letter-spacing": ".25em"
    },
    "r5": {
      "display": "inline-block",
      "width": "32px",
      "height": "1px"
    },
    "r6": {
      "margin": "0",
      "color": "#18261f",
      "font-family": "LXGW WenKai, LXGW WenKai Mono TC, Songti SC, Georgia, serif",
      "font-size": "23px",
      "font-weight": "700",
      "line-height": "1.35",
      "letter-spacing": ".12em"
    },
    "r7": {
      "margin": "20px 0 0",
      "color": "#4a6d5a",
      "font-family": "LXGW WenKai, LXGW WenKai Mono TC, Songti SC, Georgia, serif",
      "font-size": "14px",
      "font-weight": "400",
      "line-height": "1.7",
      "letter-spacing": ".1em"
    },
    "r8": {
      "margin": "40px 0 0",
      "padding-top": "20px",
      "border-top": "1px solid #ebe8df",
      "color": "#7d8490",
      "font-family": "Iowan Old Style, STSong, Songti SC, Georgia, serif",
      "font-size": "11px",
      "letter-spacing": ".1em"
    }
  },
  "variants": [
    {
      "id": "source",
      "label": "TUO masthead",
      "priority": 60,
      "visualWeight": "strong",
      "surface": "open",
      "emphasisCost": 1,
      "styles": {}
    }
  ]
}
```

模板：
```html
<section data-component-root data-style-role="r0"><section data-style-role="r4"><span data-style-role="r5"></span><span><span data-decorative><span leaf="">SYSTEM / WORKFLOW</span></span></span></section><h1 data-style-role="r6"><slot name="content"></slot></h1><p data-style-role="r7"><span data-decorative><span leaf="">文 / TUO Theme Export</span></span></p><section data-style-role="r8"><span><span data-decorative><span leaf="">TUO 本地真实渲染器</span></span></span></section></section>

      "name": "content",

      "required": true

      "font-style": "italic",
      "font-weight": "700",

      "height": "1px"
    },
    "r3": {
      "margin": "0",
      "color": "#333333",
      "font-family": "LXGW WenKai, LXGW WenKai Mono TC, Songti SC, Georgia, serif",
      "font-size": "17px",
      "font-weight": "700",
      "line-height": "1.5",
      "letter-spacing": ".04em"
    }
  },
  "variants": [
    {
      "id": "source",
      "label": "TUO heading",
      "priority": 60,
      "visualWeight": "medium",
      "surface": "open",
      "emphasisCost": 1,
      "styles": {}
    }
  ]
}
```

模板：
```html
<section data-component-root data-style-role="r0"><section data-style-role="r1"><span data-decorative><span data-decorative>//</span></span><span data-decorative data-slot-optional="marker"><slot name="marker"></slot></span><span data-decorative data-style-role="r2"></span></section><h2 data-style-role="r3"><slot name="content"></slot></h2></section>
```

## 完整文章模板骨架

该骨架由渲染器按语义块自动装配；它不含文章正文，正文只能从原文 Slot 绑定。

- article-title → `masthead`
- lead → `lead`
- heading（H2） → `heading`
- heading（H3） → `subheading`
- heading（H4） → `minor`
- paragraph / article-subtitle → `prose`
- list → `list`
- quote → `quote`
- callout → `callout`
- image → `image`
- ending → `ending`
- cta → `cta`
- code → `prose`
- divider → `prose`
- table → `prose`

## 派生版式层

这几项只由原文结构派生，不进入 source span，也不参与原文完整性比对：引言只摘取首段首句；目录只读取已识别标题；章节标签、END、作者占位和 CTA 是主题声明的版式外壳，绝不替换或改写正文。

| 元素 | 当前主题规则 |
| --- | --- |
| 引言 | 首段首句摘引；原文仍在正文原位 |
| 目录 | 最多 4 个非结语标题 |
| 英文标签 | 标题前的序号 · CHAPTER |
| END | END |
| 作者 / CTA | 我是 {{作者名}}，{{一句话简介}}。 / 如果这篇文章对你有启发，欢迎点赞、在看、转发，让它抵达需要的人。 |

## 正文行内标记预算

自动标记只在有明确语义依据时增加，绝不改写原文；作者在 Markdown 中写下的行内标记原样保留。概念词使用主题的 `strong`（加粗 + 主题色）样式，数据/时长使用 `highlight`（浅底高亮）。

| 约束 | 当前主题规则 |
| --- | --- |
| 单段自动标记 | 0–4 个；没有明确重点可为 0 |
| 短语长度 | 通常 3–15 字；关键数据、专名可更短 |
| 浅底高亮 | 单段最多 1 个 |
| 强调样式种类 | 单段最多 2 种 |
| 强锚点 | 全文最多 5 个，另由强组件预算约束 |

## 文章类型 → 组件组合配方

| 配方 | 名称 | 文章类型 | 核心组件 | 点缀组件 | 使用原则 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tutorial-steps` | 问题—步骤—结果 | tutorial | `masthead`、`heading`、`subheading`、`prose`、`list`、`ending`、`cta` | `lead`、`callout`、`image`、`quote`（≤ 3 类） | 连续步骤合并为列表；提示与结论按需使用；不让每一步成为卡片 |
| `list-guide` | 分类—清单—行动 | list-driven | `masthead`、`heading`、`subheading`、`prose`、`list`、`ending`、`cta` | `lead`、`callout`、`image`、`quote`（≤ 2 类） | 并列项目保持一组；项目说明维持正文；只突出总判断 |
| `universal` | 通用长文 | other、personal-essay、opinion-knowledge、literary-prose、tutorial、list-driven | `masthead`、`heading`、`subheading`、`prose`、`list`、`quote`、`ending`、`cta` | `lead`、`focus`、`callout`、`image`（≤ 2 类） | 普通正文不显式选组件；结构优先于装饰；不确定时保持原结构 |

## Markdown / 语义块 → 组件映射规则

Markdown 会先保真解析为 BlockDocument，再按这张表选择默认组件；少量特殊重点由 Agent 的内部渲染计划显式声明，不能随机套卡片。

| Markdown / 输入结构 | 语义块 | 标题层级 | 默认组件 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 首个标题或首段 | `article-title` | — | `masthead` |
| 标题后的首段 | `lead` | — | `lead` |
| `一、标题` / `01 | 标题` | `heading` | 2 | `heading` |
| `一、标题` / `01 | 标题` | `heading` | 3 | `subheading` |
| `一、标题` / `01 | 标题` | `heading` | 4 | `minor` |
| 普通段落、`*图注：…*` | `paragraph`、`article-subtitle` | — | `prose` |
| 连续 `-` 或 `1.` 列表 | `list` | — | `list` |
| 独立 `**重点句**` | `quote` | — | `quote` |
| 原则 / 提示语义块 | `callout` | — | `callout` |
| 图片语义块 | `image` | — | `image` |
| 结语章节内容 | `ending` | — | `ending` |
| 行动标题及其后内容 | `cta` | — | `cta` |
| `code` | `code` | — | `prose` |
| `divider` | `divider` | — | `prose` |
| `table` | `table` | — | `prose` |
